limitations: Literal source bytes only; JSON escapes are not decoded for Unicode review.
Findings are review candidates, not proof of deception or rendering behavior.
Only LF advances line numbers in both engines; BOM and CRLF bytes stay in citations.
Clock assumptions are asserted, not measured. Timeline compatibility is not causality.
Embedded logs and contexts are unredacted; source labels are inert and never reopened.
A retained independent digest binds content, not authorship, input truth or creation time.
Unicode database version is part of replay; different runtime tables may reject a receipt.

clock_model.assumption: Each source clock differs from UTC by at most this bound at every event.
clock_model.precision_assumption: Timestamps are truncated to their displayed precision.

omitted.reason: line needs an offset-aware ISO timestamp prefix or JSONL event

source_reviews.coordinates: Zero-based half-open original byte ranges; one-based line and byte column. Only LF advances line; CR and Unicode separators do not.
source_reviews.coverage: Unicode Cf; Zs/Zl/Zp except ASCII space; U+034F; U+FE00..FE0F; U+E0100..E01EF; ASCII tab.
limitations: Review candidates, not proof of deception or actual invisibility.
Joiners, selectors, spacing and tabs often have legitimate uses.
No rendering, language parsing, escape decoding, normalization or rewriting.
Not all default-ignorable characters, combining marks or Unicode risks are covered.
Context is unredacted, at most 16 bytes per side, and may split UTF-8.
Totals cover complete input even when details are omitted.
SHA-256 binds bytes, not authorship, authenticity or safety.
